payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet

condition.question: To what extent does the edited image place a frog inside the toilet bowl, as requested?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED. Assess the requested change as a whole: a frog must be visibly positioned within the toilet bowl, not merely on the lid or floor. A frog in the bowl is concrete progress; frogs elsewhere do not count as bowl placement and do not by themselves negate a frog that is in the bowl. Score full only when the requested bowl placement is clearly achieved; score partial when there is concrete but incomplete bowl placement.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the toilet in the input image. EDITED: the same toilet; distinguish its open bowl from the raised lid and surrounding floor, and assess any frog visibly positioned within the bowl.
condition.source_quote: Put a frog in the toilet
condition.aspect: A frog is placed inside the toilet bowl.
condition.endpoint: A frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl.
condition.necessity: The requested edit is to put a frog in the toilet; placing it inside the bowl directly fulfills that request.
condition.zero_when: No frog has been added or placed inside the toilet bowl; frogs only on the lid or floor do not count.
condition.half_when: There is concrete but incomplete evidence of a frog being placed in the bowl—for example, a frog is only partly positioned within the bowl or its placement is substantially ambiguous—while a substantial part of the requested bowl placement remains unfulfilled. A clearly placed frog in the bowl is not made partial merely by additional frogs elsewhere.
condition.full_when: At least one frog is clearly and substantially positioned within the toilet bowl, rather than only on the lid or floor, so the requested placement is achieved. Additional frogs elsewhere do not negate this placement.
